designSystem.provider: TheGestor local CSS and component system
evidence: Existing navy and blue tokens, light cards, compact table patterns, and local components are already used across the product.

designSystem.resolution: The discovery script reported ambiguous local component imports; resolved to the existing local CSS/component system under the maestro's explicit instruction to preserve product identity. Responsive mobile compositions use the same local tokens and CSS modules; no external component library introduced.
